Yen Converter for South Korea Travel

Convert South Korea yen to your home currency and back at a rate you set, including card fees, with typical South Korea prices for reference.

Set your own rate. Exchange rates change every day, so this converter doesn't fetch live data — enter the current rate from your bank, card provider or a currency site. The defaults are rough starting values only. Your settings are remembered in this browser.

Tips for paying in South Korea

  • When a card terminal or ATM offers to charge you in your home currency, choose yen — dynamic currency conversion usually adds a markup.
  • 7-Eleven and South Korea Post ATMs are the most reliable for foreign cards. See our money, cash & ATMs guide and how much cash to bring.
  • Shopping big? Read our tax-free shopping guide.
